# Copilot instructions

All agent instructions for this repo live in a single source of truth:
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. Follow it. Do not reintroduce
a parallel rulebook here — update AGENTS.md instead.

The old 400-line version of this file (and the deleted `.cursorrules`)
described a pre-2026 iteration of the app (flat `src/components/`,
`rdo-data.js` catalog, JS-only logic layer) and was consolidated on
2026-07-18.
